description.en: Portugal is a sovereign state located on the Iberian Peninsula in southwestern Europe, bordered by the Atlantic Ocean to the west and south, and Spain to the north and east. Renowned for its pioneering Age of Discovery maritime expeditions, deep oceanic heritage, unique Manueline and Azulejo architecture, and global trade networks, Portugal was one of the earliest global empire-builders in world history.
description.zh: Portugal是位於歐洲西南部伊比利半島西側的君主立憲先驅與現代共和國，西臨大西洋（Atlantic Ocean），東接西班牙（Spain）。葡萄牙以輝煌的大航海時代歷史、深厚的海洋文化、勇往直前的航海探險精神以及獨特的葡式城市美學聞名，是人類歷史上最早建立全球性海外殖民帝國的歐洲國家之一。

seoText.en: Explore quick facts about Portugal — population, land area, capital city, and a short overview. Learn about Belém Tower discovery, Porto sweet wines, Azulejo tiles art, Fado music melancholy, and football passion.
seoText.zh: 快速了解葡萄牙的基本資料：人口、面積、首都與簡短概述。探索貝倫塔大航海歷史、波特甜酒產地、藍瓷磚建築美學、法朵音樂哀愁以及足球巨星克里斯蒂亞諾·羅納度（C羅）文化。

list: Nestled along the scenic Atlantic coastline of the western Iberian Peninsula
A legendary historical pioneer of the 15th-century Age of Discovery
Rich marine heritage and deep roots in international maritime commerce
Vibrant European destination famous for heritage tourism and modern technology
en.text:
Portugal played a central role in human history during the Age of Discovery, mapping sea routes under explorers like Vasco da Gama and Ferdinand Magellan.

Today, the Portuguese Republic is an active EU and NATO member, excelling in solar and wind energy transition, hosting major tech hubs like Web Summit, and drawing millions to its sun-drenched beaches and historic streetscapes.

list: 位於伊比利半島西岸
大航海時代先驅國家
海洋文化與航運歷史深厚
歐洲重要觀光與文化國家
zh.text: 葡萄牙在 15 至 16 世紀的大航海時代（Age of Discovery）中扮演了改變人類歷史發展的核心角色，在達伽馬與麥哲倫等傳奇探險家的率領下，成功繪製出跨越全球的遠洋航線。如今的葡萄牙共和國是歐洲聯盟（EU）與北約（NATO）的活躍成員國，近年在太陽能與風力再生能源的轉型上表現卓越，同時因主辦如「網絡峰會」（Web Summit）等大型科技盛會而成為新興數位技術樞紐，其陽光明媚的黃金海岸與充滿古老底蘊的城市街景每年更吸引數百萬國際旅客造訪。

list: Extensive Atlantic Ocean coastline outlining the western border
Topography characterized by rolling hills and rugged northern mountains
Clear contrast in geography and rain distribution from North to South
Tagus River serves as a major geographical and economic axis
en.text:
Covering approximately 92,000 square kilometers, Portugal is dominated by hills and low mountain ranges, with limited large plains. The Tagus River (Tejo) cuts through the country to meet the ocean at Lisbon, dividing the country into two distinct regions.

The northern area is green, wet, and rugged, whereas the southern region, particularly the Algarve, features golden sandstone cliffs and a dry, warm coastal landscape.

list: 西臨大西洋海岸線長
地形以丘陵與山地為主
南北氣候與地形差異明顯
主要河流包括Tagus River
zh.text: 葡萄牙國土土地面積約為 92,000 平方公里，地形結構主要以綿延的丘陵與低矮山脈為主，大型平原相對有限。特茹河/塔霍河（Tagus River / Tejo）橫貫國境並於首都里斯本（Lisbon）匯入大西洋，這條主要河流將國家劃分為南北兩個地理與氣候迥異的區域：北部區域氣候濕潤、植被翠綠且地形崎嶇；而南部區域，特別是阿爾加維（Algarve）地區，則以宏偉的金色砂岩斷崖、乾燥溫暖的海岸線景觀與發達的度假旅遊業聞名於世。

list: Coexistence of pleasant Mediterranean and damp Atlantic climates
Southern region enjoys dry, hot, and highly sunlit summer seasons
Northern territories experience cooler and much wetter weather
Mild and highly comfortable winter seasons throughout the nation
en.text:
Portugal's climate is heavily moderated by the Atlantic Ocean, keeping weather highly pleasant. The southern Algarve region is hot and dry in summer, ideal for beaches.

In contrast, the northern region around Porto is noticeably cooler and receives high rainfall, perfect for producing world-famous wines. Winters are exceptionally mild compared to Northern Europe.

list: 地中海與海洋性氣候並存
南部較乾燥溫暖
北部較涼爽多雨
冬季溫和
zh.text: 葡萄牙的氣候深受大西洋（Atlantic Ocean）洋流的調節，整體天氣非常溫和宜人。地理上呈現地中海氣候與溫帶海洋性氣候的交織：南部阿爾加維地區夏季乾燥炎熱且日照充足，是享受海灘與日光浴的頂級天堂；相反地，以波多/波特（Porto）為核心的北部地區則明顯較為涼爽多雨，這種氣候特別適合世界聞名的波特葡萄酒產區梯田耕作。此外，與北歐和中歐相比，葡萄牙全境的冬季氣候顯得格外溫暖舒適。

list: Stable population of approximately 10 million citizens
High concentration in massive metropolitan coastal corridors
Generates massive global networks of successful overseas diasporas
Faces long-term demographic challenges of an aging population
en.text:
Portugal is home to around 10 million residents, heavily concentrated along the western coast in the Lisbon and Porto metropolitan areas.

Portuguese is the official language, and English is widely spoken in cities. Centuries of historical migration have created huge Portuguese-speaking diasporas in Brazil, France, and the US, while domestic planners work to address declining birth rates.

list: 人口約 1,000 萬
高度城市集中
移民與僑民比例高
人口老化趨勢明顯
zh.text: 葡萄牙全境目前約有 1,040 萬居民，人口高度集中在西海岸的里斯本（Lisbon）與波多（Porto）兩大沿海都會區。在族群結構上，本土葡萄牙人（Portuguese）佔總人口的 90% 以上，但近年隨著全球化移居政策，外籍居民已突破 9%，其中最大的外籍族群為來自巴西（Brazilians）的移民，約佔外籍人口的 40%，其餘主要少數族群包括來自安哥拉與維德角等前非洲殖民地的非裔移民（合計佔 15%）以及來自英國與西歐的退休外籍群體（佔 12%）。葡萄牙語為唯一官方語言，大城市中英語普及率極高。歷史上的大移民潮使葡萄牙人在巴西、法國（France）與美國（USA）等地形成了龐大的海外葡語僑民網絡，而當前國內政府則正積極推動各項福利，以應對少子化與人口老化的長遠社會結構考量。

list: Driven by robust services, hospitality, and luxury tourism industries
Pioneers rapid wind, solar, and hydroelectric green energy transition
Deep commercial reliance on maritime trade and export fleets
Successfully stabilized and growing since the 2010 debt crisis
en.text:
The Portuguese economy relies heavily on services, with high-end tourism serving as a major economic contributor. The country is a world leader in renewable energy, generating over 60% of its electricity from wind, solar, and hydro power.

Following a recovery from the 2010 Eurozone crisis, Portugal has successfully nurtured digital industries, startups, and luxury exports like cork and wine.

list: 以服務業與觀光為主
再生能源發展快速
航運與貿易重要
歐債危機後逐步復甦
zh.text: 葡萄牙經濟結構高度依賴服務業，其中高端歷史文化觀光與精緻款待產業是國家最重要的GDP貢獻源泉。同時，葡萄牙是全球再生能源轉型的先驅與領頭羊，全國有超過 60% 的電力來自風力、太陽能與水力發電。在成功走出 2010 年歐元區主權債務危機（歐債危機）的陰霾後，波蘭積極扶持數位新創產業、軟體研發以及數位游牧生態圈，並持續擴大葡萄酒、全球第一的軟木塞製品（Cork）等高端傳統製造業的出口量。

list: Semi-presidential representative democratic republic framework
President serves as a unifying ceremonial head of state
Prime Minister wields executive administrative authority
Stable multi-party system with mature coalition transfers
en.text:
Portugal operates under a stable semi-presidential republic. The President represents the nation and can veto legislation, while the Prime Minister leads the government and executes policy.

Political culture is marked by moderation and consensus. As an early member of the EU and NATO, Portugal is fully aligned with mainstream European security and fiscal guidelines.

list: 議會共和制
多黨民主制度
EU與NATO成員國
政治相對穩定
zh.text: 葡萄牙政治體制採行穩固的半總統制代表民主共和國架構。總統由普選產生，主要扮演凝聚國家認同的象徵性元首並享有法案否決權；總理則為內閣首腦，掌握實質行政權並全權領導政府推行政策。政黨政治文化向來以溫和、協商與成熟的政黨輪替見長。作為歐盟（EU）與北約（NATO）的資深創始或早期成員國，葡萄牙在外交安全與財政方針上均與歐洲主流核心價值高度契合。

list: Leisurely lifestyle tempo with strong focus on life quality
Ranks globally as one of the safest and most peaceful nations
Family values and tight local communities remain highly central
Evident contrasts in modernization between cities and quiet villages
en.text:
Portugal offers a relaxed lifestyle, often rated as one of the safest countries on Earth. Tight-knit family bonds and community hospitality are core values.

While Lisbon and Porto are buzzing hubs of startup events and global remote workers, rural communities preserve slower, traditional ways of farming and community festivals.

list: 生活節奏悠閒
社會安全性高
家庭文化重要
城市與鄉村差異明顯
zh.text: 葡萄牙社會以舒適悠閒的生活步調聞名，並長年高居全球和平指數前列，被公認為世界上最安全、最和平的國家之一。緊密的家庭親族紐帶與對外來客人的熱情款待是其核心價值觀。雖然里斯本與波多等大都會如今已是國際新創活動、數位游牧民族與遠端工作者雲集的現代科技化溫床，但廣大的鄉村與海邊小鎮依然完好保留了節奏緩慢、依循傳統農業與地方守護神節慶的質樸生活方式。

list: Priceless cultural heritage left by the maritime Age of Discovery
Melancholy Fado music recognized as UNESCO intangible heritage
Stunning blue Azulejo ceramic tiles decorating urban architecture
Deep, absolute cultural devotion to national football and sports
en.text:
Portuguese culture is deeply tied to the sea, visible in Manueline stone-carvings. Fado is a soulful, melancholic musical style expressing longing (saudade), recognized by UNESCO.

Cities are famous for beautiful hand-painted blue-and-white Azulejo ceramic tiles on buildings. Football is a national passion, producing global icons like Eusébio, Luís Figo, and Cristiano Ronaldo.

list: 大航海時代文化遺產
Fado音樂聞名
藍瓷（Azulejos）建築特色
足球文化極為重要
zh.text: 葡萄牙文化與海洋有著血濃於水的歷史不解之緣，這深刻體現在揉合海洋與船錨元素的曼努埃爾式（Manueline）石雕建築中。享譽國際的「法朵」（Fado）是一種富含靈魂深度、音調哀怨憂傷的傳統音樂風格，完美詮釋了葡語中特有的命運鄉愁與思念（Saudade），已被列入聯合國教科文組織（UNESCO）非物質文化遺產。城市建築外牆廣泛裝飾著精美手工彩繪的藍白瓷磚（Azulejos），形塑了獨一無二的視覺景觀。此外，足球是全民靈魂寄託的絕對信仰，歷史上孕育了黑豹尤西比奧、費戈以及當代足球巨星克里斯蒂亞諾·羅納度（C羅，Cristiano Ronaldo）等世界級傳奇。

list: Addressing aging population curves and youth workforce brain drain
Managing massive tourism gentrification and rising housing costs
Transitioning economic structures to decrease tourism reliance
Correcting the extreme concentration of resources in Lisbon
en.text:
Portugal faces structural issues with low average salaries driving educated youth abroad, paired with an aging local population. Hotspots like Lisbon deal with high real estate costs and tourism gentrification.

The government is focused on diversifying the economy through tech incentives, digital nomad visas, and decentralizing resources outside major hubs.

list: 人口老化與勞動力不足
房價上升與旅遊壓力
經濟依賴觀光
城市過度集中
zh.text: 葡萄牙目前面臨著結構性的社會挑戰：國內平均薪資水平偏低導致大量高學歷青年工程師外移西歐，同時伴隨著嚴重的本土人口老化。此外，觀光海嘯令一線熱點如里斯本與波多面臨嚴重的地產炒作與「觀光紳士化」（Gentrification），導致本地新婚家庭房價負擔沉重。為了解決經濟過度依賴觀光業與資源向首都極端傾斜的問題，當前當局正大力推動數位科技租稅優惠、跨國人才簽證，並積極將中央資源分散至中北部非核心城市。

list: Lisbon — Beautiful hills capital known for yellow trams and views
Porto — Historic riverside city famous for Port wine cellars
Algarve — Famous coastal region boasting spectacular sea cliffs
Belém Tower — Crown monument celebrating the Age of Discovery
en.text:
Lisbon is famous for its yellow vintage trams and panoramic hilltop vistas (miradouros). Porto features the majestic Dom Luís I Bridge, overlooking historic port wine cellars.

The Algarve coast offers warm waters, sea arches, and pristine golden sand. The Belém Tower in Lisbon, a UNESCO monument, stands as a historic sentinel of Portugal's maritime exploration.

list: Lisbon——首都與最大城市
Porto——葡萄酒與文化城市
Algarve——著名海灘度假區
Belém Tower——大航海時代象徵
zh.text: 國家政治與經濟樞紐里斯本（Lisbon）是一座美麗的七丘之城，以其穿梭在窄巷間的復古黃色28號電車與遍布全城的絕美山丘觀景台（Miradouros）風光征服無數旅客。北方的歷史文化名城波多（Porto）則坐擁橫跨杜羅河的雄偉路易一世大橋（Dom Luís I Bridge），河畔兩岸開滿了傳承百年的老字號波特酒莊地窖。南部的阿爾加維（Algarve）海岸線由溫暖的海水、鬼斧神工的海蝕拱門與純淨的金色沙灘組成，是全歐洲最著名的避寒與海灘度假勝地。而傲然矗立於里斯本特茹河畔、被列為聯合國教科文組織世界遺產的貝倫塔（Belém Tower），至今仍是象徵葡萄牙大航海時代冒險精神的永恆歷史哨兵。

list: Active member state of the unified European Union
A proud founding member state of the military NATO alliance
Extremely close diplomatic and linguistic ties with Brazil
Champions international ocean governance and clean sea trade
en.text:
Portugal acts as a stable, globally connected EU member. It shares unique historical, economic, and emotional links with Brazil and portuguese-speaking African nations through the CPLP alliance.

As a founding member of NATO, it holds a key position in Atlantic defense. The country is an active voice in global oceanic treaties and environmental conservation.

list: European Union成員國
NATO創始成員之一
與Brazil關係密切
重視海洋外交與貿易
zh.text: 葡萄牙在歐盟（European Union）與北約（NATO）內部一向扮演著立場穩健、連結全球的中堅力量。透過「葡萄牙語國家共同體（CPLP）」的政治架構，葡萄牙與巴西（Brazil）以及多個非洲葡語系國家維持著極其親密且具備深厚歷史、經濟與情感紐帶的外交關係。作為北約的創始成員國之一，其地處大西洋與地中海交匯點的地理特質使其在北大西洋防務防線上居於關鍵核心。同時，葡萄牙也常年在聯合國等國際舞台上為全球海洋安全治理、藍色經濟與海洋生態永續保育發出強烈呼籲。

list: Stable trade exchanges in hardware parts, textiles, and seafood
Growing tourism travel and Portuguese cultural exchanges
Absence of formal diplomatic relations with friendly communication
Indirect maritime logistics and ocean shipping connections
en.text:
Portugal and Taiwan maintain friendly, non-official commercial ties. Bilateral trade is stable, focusing on advanced manufacturing machinery, textiles, electronics, and cork products.

Cultural ties are growing, with more Taiwanese tourists exploring historic Portuguese streets and experiencing Fado music, while universities promote academic exchange programs.

list: 經經幕交流有限但穩定
觀光與文化互動增加
無正式外交關係
海運與貿易有間接連結
zh.text: 葡萄牙與台灣之間雖然並無正式邦交，但雙邊長期在互利基礎上維持著友好且穩定的非官方經貿、海運物流與民間文化往來。雙邊貿易結構穩定，台灣主要向葡萄牙採購高端軟木製品、葡萄酒、精緻食品與部分紡織原料，而台灣的高科技電子零組件、工具機與精密硬體部件也是葡萄牙製造業轉型所需的重要供應來源。近年來，隨著台灣民眾赴歐旅遊風氣日盛，前往葡萄牙老城區自由行、體驗法朵音樂與藍瓷藝術的台灣旅客人數逐年增加，兩國高等學府之間針對語文學習與學術交換的研究專案也正逐步擴大互动。

list: A legendary founding pioneer of the maritime Age of Discovery
Home of Fado music culture expressing profound melancholy
The westernmost nation of mainland Europe facing the Atlantic
Global hotspot for football culture and elite sports legends
大航海時代起源國之一
Fado音樂文化代表國
歐洲最西端國家之一
足球文化極為盛行

text.en: Iberian Flag — The iconic red and green flag with the historic Portuguese Armillary Sphere representing pioneering Age of Discovery
text.zh: 伊比利亞雙色國旗——象徵大航海精神的紅綠雙色國旗，中央鑲嵌著歷史悠久的「渾天儀」與盾牌勳章，代表著探險開拓的光榮血脈

text.en: Age of Discovery — The spectacular Belém Tower standing beside Tagus River commemorating historic naval expeditions and Vasco da Gama
text.zh: 大航海先驅貝倫塔——矗立於特茹河畔、承載著曼努埃爾式建築美學的貝倫塔與航海家紀念碑，是葡萄牙地理大發現黃金時代的豐碑

text.en: Azulejo Ceramic Art — Exquisite blue-and-white hand-painted tiles decorating historical streetscapes, churches, and palaces
text.zh: 藍白瓷磚（Azulejos）——精美的手工彩繪藍瓷磚廣泛鑲嵌於老城街道、火車站與宮殿外牆，是葡萄牙極具辨識度且獨步全球的城市藝術名片

text.en: Port Wine & Douro — The world-renowned sweet, fortified Port wine produced along the scenic mountain terraced vineyards of Douro valley
text.zh: 杜羅河谷波特酒——出產自世界自然遺產杜羅河谷梯田的「波特酒」（Port Wine），甘甜醇厚、享譽全球，是葡萄牙獨一無二的傳世佳釀

text.en: Melancholic Fado Music — Soulful, emotional UNESCO-recognized singing expressing profound longing and saudade maritime history
text.zh: 命運之歌法朵（Fado）——被列為聯合國非物質文化遺產的靈魂吟唱，伴隨葡萄牙吉他，傾訴著對海洋的哀思與「Saudade」靈魂渴望
